Messages.Body:
Troll2Jeux will be holding Stone's usual December event this year again.

Pre-registrations: www.veknfrance.com/forum/viewtopic.php?t=17092
Registration: 10:20 - 10:50.
Registration fee: 5 EUR
Opaque sleeves are required.
Decklist is required
3R+F

Round 1: 11:00

A special prize will be offered to the player with the most "Tend the Flock" points. Rules on how to gain "Tend the Flock" points can be found in the pre-registration link.
